name: com.storkstudios.datawaste
description:
Stork'Studios' network communication system. Created to simplify performing network related tasks in our games.
Use cases include telemetry and fetching data from a server in runtime.

A prefab configured with some reasonable defaults is available in samples.

Unity Converters for Newtonsoft.Json package may be useful for serializing Unity data types. It is available at https://openupm.com/packages/jillejr.newtonsoft.json-for-unity.converters/

Sources available at https://github.com/StorkStudios/DataWaste

samples.description: A sample telemetry configuration - reasonable defaults for usage in new projects.
